module_description: Who can open which screen, and what they may do there.
delete_description: A role still assigned to users cannot be removed.

descriptions.report-template: Print and export layouts: output format, paper size and orientation.
descriptions.approval-workflow: Build the approval chains documents must clear, step by step and by value band.
descriptions.mail-service: Outgoing mail relays and who each service writes to. Passwords stay in the server environment.
descriptions.ledger-integration: Which Chart of Account ledgers each source posts to — Machinery's costs arrive in Finance as draft vouchers.
descriptions.rule-violation: Business rules broken on documents, by rule, with severity and what became of each.
descriptions.global-notification: Send a notice to everyone, a role or one user — maintenance windows, alerts, announcements.
descriptions.document-deletion: Requests to delete a posted document, with the reason and the decision.
descriptions.user-rule-mapping: Which business rules a user may override when the system raises a violation.
descriptions.user-requisition-mapping: Set which requisition types a user may raise or approve, and up to what value.
descriptions.user-store-mapping: Bind users to the stores they may issue from, receive into or adjust.
descriptions.user-company-mapping: Give a user access to one or more group companies and set their default.
descriptions.user-production-category-mapping: Which production floors a user may plan for and report production on.
descriptions.menu-report-mapping: The reports offered on a screen, in order, with its default.
descriptions.module-registration: The ERP modules: rename, re-icon, reorder or hide one for this company. New modules come with the code.
descriptions.lookup-table: Named lists of dropdown values — Shift, Payment Term, Shipment Mode and your own.
descriptions.lookup-value: The values of the chosen table.
descriptions.system-parameter: The rules the system follows for this company, with where each value comes from and who last changed it.
descriptions.category-permission: Which item categories a role may view, create, edit and approve in.
descriptions.role-definition: Roles with their code, Bangla name, rank and whether they bypass the menu matrix.
descriptions.role-menu: Which screens a role may open, and what it may do on each: View, Create, Edit, Delete, Approve, Print, Export.
descriptions.menu-definition: The menu tree: rename, reorder or hide screens. New screens come with the code.
descriptions.user-account: Every sign-in account: User ID, type, employee code, roles, two-factor method, last sign-in and status.
descriptions.password-change: Set somebody's password, and the record of every password change.
descriptions.buyer-fabric-rights: Allow a user to issue, receive, transfer or return fabric for a given buyer.
descriptions.fabric-defect-mapping: Map buyer-specific defect penalty points onto the four-point inspection system.
descriptions.buyer-store-mapping: Nominate the stores that hold each buyer's material.
descriptions.buyer-item-category-mapping: Record the item categories, and any nomination codes, each buyer mandates.
descriptions.tna-task-status: Track time-and-action milestones against their planned and actual dates.

rules.module-registration: Changes apply to this company only. A hidden module leaves the sidebar with all its screens.
rules.lookup-table: Open the values of a table to add, change or delete them. A change to a system table makes a copy of it for your company only (Company copy); delete that copy to go back to the starting list.
rules.lookup-value: Every value can be changed or deleted. A code is unique within its table.
rules.role-definition: System roles are read-only — copy one in Roles to change it. An admin role holds every permission; grant it to as few roles as possible.

system_role_note: This is a system role, so its menus cannot be changed here. Copy it in Roles first, then assign menus to the copy.
admin_role_note: This is an admin role: it holds every permission, so every box is ticked and cannot be cleared.
flag_unavailable: This screen has nothing to grant for this column
choose_lookup: Choose a table to see its values.
lookup_copy_hint: Every value can be changed or deleted. A change to a starting list makes a copy of it for your company only; other companies keep theirs. Delete the company copy in the table list to go back to the starting list.
lookup_code_taken: A lookup table with this code already exists.
lookup_system_read_only: This is a shared system entry, so it cannot be changed. Add your own instead.
search_parameters: Search by group, key, parameter or value…
param_note: A parameter is defined by the code that reads it, so new ones come with the code. A factory's own values are set under System Setting → Level.
category_unrestricted: This role has no category rows, so it is not restricted by category. Tick categories to restrict it to them.
category_restricted: This role is restricted to the ticked categories (and their sub-categories).
no_categories: No item categories yet. Add them in the Store item library first.
search_categories: Search categories by name or code…
password_policy_hint: At least 10 characters, and not one that has appeared in a known breach.
category_note: Ticking Create, Edit or Approve also ticks View.
search_accounts: Search by type, user ID, name, mail, employee code or role…
force_change: Force a change at next sign-in

ui.new_lookup_hint: A new table starts empty. Add its values on the Lookup Tables tab, where they appear in every dropdown bound to it.
ui.lookup_code_help: The key application code refers to this list by. It cannot be changed afterwards.
ui.factory_level_hint: Pick a factory to give it its own value for the keys that allow one; the rest follow the company.
ui.role_admin_help: An admin role bypasses the menu matrix entirely. Grant it to as few roles as possible.
ui.rights: V C E D A P X
ui.menu_grant_hint: The rights one role has on one screen. Ticking any right also needs View to open the screen.
ui.new_user_hint: The password and memorable word are hashed before they are stored; neither is ever kept in clear. Grant further roles on the User Roles tab.
ui.change_password_hint: Set a new password for an account. Its holder can be made to change it at their next sign-in.
ui.category_hint: The item categories one role may view, create, edit and approve in. Create, Edit or Approve also means View.

mapping.approval_limit_help: Blank means no ceiling. Ignored unless the user may approve.
mapping.choose_to_begin_hint: The full list loads once one is selected, with everything held today already ticked.
mapping.current_company: A user leaves this company from User Account Registration, not here.
mapping.not_administered: You do not administer users in that company.

flag_help.adjust: Stock adjustment rewrites the book quantity — grant it sparingly.
flag_help.override: Overrides are always logged, whoever holds them.
flag_help.default_company: Setting this clears the flag on the user's other companies.
flag_help.default_report: Setting this clears the flag on the menu's other reports.
flag_help.critical: A critical defect rejects the roll regardless of the point total.
flag_help.sub_style: Labels and size-dependent trims differ between the colourways of one style, so those categories are booked per sub-style.
flag_help.default_store: Setting this clears the flag on the buyer's other stores.

hints.user-rule-mapping: A user with no rule rows may not override any violation.
hints.user-requisition-mapping: The limit is compared against the requisition's total value at the moment approval is attempted.
hints.user-store-mapping: A user with no store rows can see stock reports but cannot post a store operation.
hints.user-company-mapping: The user signs in to the default company; the others are a switch away.
hints.user-production-category-mapping: A user with no category rows is not limited by category.
hints.menu-report-mapping: The first report by display order opens unless another is the default.
hints.buyer-fabric-rights: Rights are checked at the moment a fabric operation is posted, against the window recorded here.
hints.fabric-defect-mapping: Where a buyer has no row for a defect, the defect's own default points are used.
hints.buyer-store-mapping: Goods received against a buyer's order default to the store nominated here.
hints.buyer-item-category-mapping: Purchase orders for a buyer are restricted to the categories listed here once the first row exists.

mapping.name: Name
mapping.penalty_points_help: Four-point system: 1 to 4 points per occurrence.
mapping.defect_order_help: Where the defect sits on this buyer's inspection sheet.
mapping.nomination_code_help: The buyer's own reference for their nominated supplier, where they have one.
mapping.effective_to_help: Leave blank for an open-ended permission.
mapping.points_range: Four-point system: 1 to 4 points per occurrence.
mapping.to_after_from: Effective To cannot be before Effective From.

matrix_hints.fabric-defect-mapping: The defects counted on a buyer's inspection sheet, their penalty points and the order they are listed in.
matrix_hints.buyer-store-mapping: Which buyer accounts hold stock in a store. Pick the store, tick its buyers.
matrix_hints.buyer-item-category-mapping: The item categories a buyer nominates, and which of them are booked per sub-style.

grey.hint: Which booking categories grey fabric may be moved between, for one buyer account.
grey.pick_hint: Its transfer rules load beside it.
grey.none_hint: Add the first one with Add rule above.
grey.refusal: The absence of a rule is a refusal, so a new buyer starts with nothing transferable. Fabric knitted for sample was costed differently from bulk — that is the move this screen governs.
grey.same: From and To must be different categories.
grey.exists: This rule is already in the list.

config.password_env_format: Name an environment variable in capitals, e.g. SMTP_PASSWORD — never the password itself.
config.email_list: Enter email addresses separated by commas.

cfg.gl_hint: A GL source names where an amount comes from; its COA lines say which ledgers it debits and credits.
cfg.gl_link_ref_hint: The system's sources (MACHINERY_…) keep theirs; the code posts by it.
cfg.gl_final_bill_hint: Bank bill sources only — this header covers the final settlement.
cfg.gl_pick_source: Pick a GL source to see and set its COA lines.
cfg.gl_lines_hint: A posting debits the first DEBIT ledger and credits the first CREDIT ledger. Machinery's costs arrive as draft vouchers for Finance to approve and post.
cfg.gl_source_taken: A GL source with this name already exists.
cfg.gl_link_ref_reserved: That Link Ref belongs to a system source.
cfg.gl_source_in_use: This GL source is the system's or has posted vouchers; deactivate it instead.
cfg.report_template_hint: A screen prints or exports through its template; the code is how the screen names it.
cfg.title: Title
cfg.password_env_help: The name of the server environment variable holding the password — never the password itself.
cfg.default_relay_help: Mail with no relay of its own goes out through this one. Only one relay is the default.
cfg.violation_hint: Each module records its own violations when a mapped user overrides a rule; one can also be recorded by hand.
cfg.choose_scope: Choose a rule to see what was raised against it.
cfg.audience_target_help: Only for a Role or User audience.
cfg.notification_hint: Saved active, it is delivered at once as an in-app notification; editing the record later sends nothing again.
cfg.deletion_hint: The document is deleted by its own module once that module is built; until then the request and decision are kept here.
cfg.choose_type: Choose a document type to see its requests.

f.name: Event Name
f.default_status_help: The state a fresh instance of this event starts in.
f.offset_days_help: Days relative to shipment. Negative is before shipment.
f.is_repeat_help: Raised once per colour or delivery rather than once per order.

tna.records_hint: Time-and-action events with their order, section, owner, repeat behaviour and buyer-feedback requirement
tna.new_hint: Name the people notified beyond the owning desk on the Mapped User List tab. Raise the event against a style on the TNA Task Status tab.
tna.edit_hint: Rewriting :code. Save to keep the changes, or cancel to leave it as it was.
tna.instances_hint: Pick a calendar event to see every style it has been raised against, and update where each one stands.
tna.none_hint: Add the first one with Raise instance above.
tna.count: :count instances. Status accepts Pending, In Progress, Completed, Delayed or Cancelled. Completing an instance stamps today’s date as the actual date.
tna.users_hint: The people notified when a calendar event is raised, beyond the desk that owns it.

v.code_taken: This event code is already in use.
v.name: Event Name is required.
v.parent_self: An event cannot be its own parent.

module_guard.title: This module is not enabled
module_guard.body: Your company has not been given this module yet. Ask the platform (AnnotechERP support) to switch it on.

setup_guard.title: This screen is for administrators
setup_guard.body: Master data, company settings and setup screens are kept by the Owner, Company Admin and Factory Admin. Ask an administrator if you need it.
